svg.text: I like taking things apart to see how they actually work. Most days that means a machine
learning experiment or a simulation — the "let's see what happens" kind of programming, not
the roadmap-driven kind. I'll pull something apart, break it, and figure out how to put it
back together, usually better than it started.
